title: Mini-Opera Links
tagline: easy cUSD payments onboarding onto mini-opera for central africa
description:
we made a payments app!

we created an easy way to send cUSD via links directly from the mini-opera browser. this improves the current onboarding flow that requires payment recipients to already have mini-opera. now, users can simply send a link that can be claimed using any wallet, including the mini-opera wallet. Fully non-custodial and permissionless, of course
how_its_made:
Technologies we use: NextJS, Foundry, Celo, MiniPay, Ngrok, Peanut Protocol

Our payment links are based on the Peanut contracts, which uses secret-protected vault smart contracts. the sender puts tokens into the vault and shares the the secret with the recipient, in our case in the shape of an url. this url has a secret that lets the recipient take out the money. we deployed on celo-alfajores and celo mainnet, integrated cUSD, and built the entire miniPay specific dapp from scratch.
